d: Magnificent place destined for wedding feast. Chorus of Cappellii, Juliet, Matilde, then Chorus of Montecchii, and Romeo with Gilberto; at the end Everardo, with Teobaldo.
Romeo under the sign of the Cappellii, Gilberto, and said.
Courtyards of Palazzo Cappellio. Teobaldo with the Choir of Cappellii, and Fighters of his faction.
The above, and Romeo with his Montecchii, who comes out fighting against the Cappellii.
Recinct secluded, with low times, in one end of the palazzo de' Cappellii. Secret door that puts to the street. Romeo with the followers, then Teobaldo also with Séguito.
The above, Gilberto, then Everardo, Juliet with Matilde.
Remote location of the city. Gilberto, Everardo.
Garden. Night with moon that illuminates. Romeo, Gilberto, and follow Montecchii.
Cabinet, as in the first act, which is illuminated by candles on top of a table. Juliet, then Matilde.
Everard, Matilde, Choir of Hats, and sayings

The funeral place with lamps lit, where the tombs of the Cappellii stand. Juliet's with inscription will be in discreet eminence with steps on foot, so that she can open it, and let it go out in her time. Romeo, and Chorus of Montecchii; Juliet in the grave.
